_doc: A person to talk to (game/scripts/npc.gd). location: where the person stands (default: the start location). position/face/stand in Godot metres. model: the figure, assets/characters/<model>.glb from characters/<model>/recipe.json (scripts/make_character.py); without it, or without the GLB, the procedural figure coloured by palette. assets: folder with portrait.jpg, idle/ and per clip <clip>.wav plus <clip>/0001.jpg... frames at fps; the story's `# line:<clip>` tags name the clips. What the person says is the knot talk_<id> in game/data/story/<id>.ink. Optional: knot (another entry knot), fallback {location, position, face, stand} (where the person stands while `location` has no export). Source material: characters/marl/.
name: Sergeant Marl
